name: Sarda Energy & Minerals Ltd (SEML)
tagline: Chhattisgarh-based integrated steel/ferro-alloys/power flagship of Sarda Group, growing fast (75% YoY revenue) with an ambitious capacity-doubling plan
business_overview: Sarda Energy & Minerals (incorporated 1973), the flagship company of Sarda Group, is engaged in production of steel, ferro alloys and power, with coal and iron-ore mining assets in Chhattisgarh.
fundamentals_table: ~Rs 1,604 Cr (debt Rs 2,861 Cr, cash Rs 1,257 Cr)
fundamentals_narrative: Genuinely strong recent growth (75.47% YoY revenue, 41.99% YoY net profit) alongside solid ROCE (17.4%) and ROE (16.1%). Some net debt (~Rs 1,604 Cr) but manageable relative to scale. Management is guiding an ambitious near-doubling of power generation capacity (930 MW to >1,720 MW), plus expanding coal/iron-ore mining pipeline — real capacity-backed growth, not just commodity price pass-through.
technical_read: Trading around Rs 514, roughly mid-range within its Rs 453-640 52-week band.
sentiment_summary: Moderately active VP thread (29 replies, last activity 2026-05-29) with substantive, detailed concall coverage.
community_signal: ranvir (well-known top contributor, 2026-05-29, 1 love) posted detailed Q4/FY26 concall highlights: current power capacity 930 MW growing to >1,720 MW, active coal mining (Gare Palma, Tamnar) and iron ore mining (Dongarbore) with several new blocks in the pipeline, plus 50 MW solar under construction (Q1 FY27 commissioning) — a specific, well-documented capacity-expansion thesis from a repeat, credible poster.
bse_notes: Not checked this pass — no red-flag corporate actions surfaced in search.
bull_case: 75% YoY revenue growth and 42% YoY profit growth are genuinely strong, not just base-effect noise
Concrete, quantified capacity-expansion plan (power capacity to nearly double) backed by a detailed concall from a credible community poster
Vertically integrated (own coal + iron ore mining feeding steel/ferro-alloy/power production) supports margin durability
ROCE/ROE both healthy at mid-teens to high-teens
bear_case: Steel/ferro-alloys/power remains commodity-price and cycle-sensitive despite the vertical integration
Net debt of ~Rs 1,600 Cr will grow further to fund the capacity expansion, adding execution and leverage risk
At Rs 18,125 Cr market cap, already a well-covered mid-large-cap — a 10x/100x re-rating needs an exceptional, sustained catalyst beyond capacity growth
verdict_headline: Real, capacity-backed growth story with credible community coverage — but market cap size keeps this outside the screen's 10x/100x bar
verdict_reasoning: 75% YoY revenue growth plus a concrete, quantified capacity-doubling plan is a genuinely strong combination
But at Rs 18,125 Cr, even sustained execution on the expansion plan is unlikely to deliver a 10x-in-2-3-years or 100x-in-10-years outcome
One of the stronger 'neither' names in this batch — worth tracking for continued execution

four_box.note: Concrete, quantified power-capacity-doubling plan (930MW->1,720MW+) + expanding coal/iron-ore mining pipeline is a real capacity-backed tailwind; already a well-covered Rs18,125cr mid-large-cap needing 'an exceptional, sustained catalyst' — tam no; vertically integrated (own coal+iron ore feeding steel/ferro-alloy/power) is a genuine structural moat; growing net debt (~Rs1,604cr) to fund expansion — valuation weak, no market_expectation data.
